name: Orbital Economy v7.4 Intermediate Inputs candidate r1
description: Candidate r1: Metal becomes the physical intermediate input of Electronics behind Intermediate Inputs Enabled; Modes 0-16 remain on the exact legacy branches.

add_elements.name: Intermediate Inputs Enabled
add_elements.description: Master switch for v7.4 Metal-to-Electronics intermediate-input coupling. Modes 0-16 override to 0; Modes 17+ enable it.

add_elements.name: Metal per Electronics
add_elements.description: Physical Metal units consumed per unit of Electronics in the v7.4 coupled branch. Initial calibration candidate r1.

add_elements.name: Metal Input Target Days
add_elements.description: Target Electronics-owned Metal/feedstock buffer measured in days of coupled consumption. Initial candidate r1 value from the approved specification.

add_elements.name: Metal Input Adjustment Time
add_elements.description: Adjustment time in days for the Electronics Metal input buffer demand. Initial candidate r1 value from the approved specification.

add_elements.name: Test 18 Metal Supply Shock Active
add_elements.description: v7.4 test harness only: temporary B Metal supply shock, day 360-720.

add_elements.name: Test 19 Coupled Electronics Growth Active
add_elements.description: v7.4 test harness only: sustained A Electronics demand growth with intermediate-input coupling.

add_elements.name: Test 20 Coupled Metal Demand Growth Active
add_elements.description: v7.4 test harness only: sustained B final Metal demand growth with intermediate-input coupling.

add_elements.name: v7.4 Metal Supply Shock Multiplier
add_elements.description: Temporary B mining-capacity multiplier used only by Mode 18.

add_elements.name: v7.4 Coupled Electronics Growth Multiplier
add_elements.description: Sustained A Electronics local-demand multiplier used only by Mode 19.

add_elements.name: v7.4 Coupled Metal Demand Growth Multiplier
add_elements.description: Sustained B final Metal local-demand multiplier used only by Mode 20.

add_elements.name: A Electronics Metal Input Target Inventory

behavior.value: [A Electronics Feedstock Consumption Rate] * [Metal Input Target Days]

add_elements.description: Target Electronics-owned Metal buffer in A, expressed in physical Metal units.

add_elements.name: A Electronics Metal Input Demand

behavior.value: Max(0, [A Electronics Feedstock Consumption Rate] + ([A Electronics Metal Input Target Inventory] - [A Electronics Feedstock Inventory]) / [Metal Input Adjustment Time])

add_elements.description: Physical Metal input demand of Electronics in A: current consumption plus buffer adjustment.

add_elements.name: A Metal Available for Intermediate Use

behavior.value: [A Electronics Metal Input Demand] * [A Metal Inventory] / ([A Metal Inventory] + [A Metal Buffer])

add_elements.description: Metal available to Electronics in A, using the same inventory availability factor as final local Metal sales.

add_elements.name: A Electronics Metal Input Delivery

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [A Metal Available for Intermediate Use], 0)

add_elements.description: Physical transfer of Metal from the A Metal sector into the Electronics-owned feedstock buffer.

add_elements.name: A Electronics Metal Input Fulfillment

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, IfThenElse([A Electronics Metal Input Demand] > 0.001, [A Electronics Metal Input Delivery] / [A Electronics Metal Input Demand], 1), 1)

add_elements.description: Fraction of Electronics Metal input demand fulfilled in A; exactly 1 when v7.4 coupling is disabled.

add_elements.name: B Electronics Metal Input Target Inventory

behavior.value: [B Electronics Feedstock Consumption Rate] * [Metal Input Target Days]

add_elements.description: Target Electronics-owned Metal buffer in B, expressed in physical Metal units.

add_elements.name: B Electronics Metal Input Demand

behavior.value: Max(0, [B Electronics Feedstock Consumption Rate] + ([B Electronics Metal Input Target Inventory] - [B Electronics Feedstock Inventory]) / [Metal Input Adjustment Time])

add_elements.description: Physical Metal input demand of Electronics in B: current consumption plus buffer adjustment.

add_elements.name: B Metal Available for Intermediate Use

behavior.value: [B Electronics Metal Input Demand] * [B Metal Inventory] / ([B Metal Inventory] + [B Metal Buffer])

add_elements.description: Metal available to Electronics in B, using the same inventory availability factor as final local Metal sales.

add_elements.name: B Electronics Metal Input Delivery

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [B Metal Available for Intermediate Use], 0)

add_elements.description: Physical transfer of Metal from the B Metal sector into the Electronics-owned feedstock buffer.

add_elements.name: B Electronics Metal Input Fulfillment

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, IfThenElse([B Electronics Metal Input Demand] > 0.001, [B Electronics Metal Input Delivery] / [B Electronics Metal Input Demand], 1), 1)

add_elements.description: Fraction of Electronics Metal input demand fulfilled in B; exactly 1 when v7.4 coupling is disabled.

replace_formulas.name: A Electronics Feedstock Extraction Rate
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, 0, [A Positive Desired Electronics Feedstock Extraction Rate] / (1 + ([A Positive Desired Electronics Feedstock Extraction Rate] / ([A Electronics Feedstock Extraction Capacity] + 0.001)) ^ 8) ^ 0.125)

replace_formulas.name: A Electronics Feedstock Consumption Rate
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [A Electronics Production Rate] * [Metal per Electronics], [A Electronics Production Rate] * [A Feedstock per Electronics])

replace_formulas.name: A Electronics Feedstock Price
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [A Market Price], [A Effective Electronics Feedstock Base Cost] * (1 + [A Electronics Feedstock Scarcity Strength] * [A Electronics Feedstock Shortage] / [A Electronics Feedstock Target Inventory]))

replace_formulas.name: A Electronics Unit Cost
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [Metal per Electronics] * [A Electronics Feedstock Price] + [A Electronics Energy per Unit] * [A Energy Price] + [A Electronics Labor per Unit] * [A Wage], [A Feedstock per Electronics] * [A Electronics Feedstock Price] + [A Electronics Energy per Unit] * [A Energy Price] + [A Electronics Labor per Unit] * [A Wage])

replace_formulas.name: A Electronics Feedstock Target Inventory
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [A Electronics Metal Input Target Inventory], 1200)

replace_formulas.name: A Desired Smelting Rate
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [A Local Sales] + [Shipment Rate A to B] - [Shipment Rate B to A] + ([A Metal Target Inventory] - [A Metal Inventory]) / [A Metal Adjustment Time] + [A Electronics Metal Input Delivery], [A Local Sales] + [Shipment Rate A to B] - [Shipment Rate B to A] + ([A Metal Target Inventory] - [A Metal Inventory]) / [A Metal Adjustment Time])

replace_formulas.name: B Electronics Feedstock Extraction Rate
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, 0, [B Positive Desired Electronics Feedstock Extraction Rate] / (1 + ([B Positive Desired Electronics Feedstock Extraction Rate] / ([B Electronics Feedstock Extraction Capacity] + 0.001)) ^ 8) ^ 0.125)

replace_formulas.name: B Electronics Feedstock Consumption Rate
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [B Electronics Production Rate] * [Metal per Electronics], [B Electronics Production Rate] * [B Feedstock per Electronics])

replace_formulas.name: B Electronics Feedstock Price
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [B Market Price], [B Effective Electronics Feedstock Base Cost] * (1 + [B Electronics Feedstock Scarcity Strength] * [B Electronics Feedstock Shortage] / [B Electronics Feedstock Target Inventory]))

replace_formulas.name: B Electronics Unit Cost
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [Metal per Electronics] * [B Electronics Feedstock Price] + [B Electronics Energy per Unit] * [B Energy Price] + [B Electronics Labor per Unit] * [B Wage], [B Feedstock per Electronics] * [B Electronics Feedstock Price] + [B Electronics Energy per Unit] * [B Energy Price] + [B Electronics Labor per Unit] * [B Wage])

replace_formulas.name: B Electronics Feedstock Target Inventory
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [B Electronics Metal Input Target Inventory], 1200)

replace_formulas.name: B Desired Smelting Rate
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, [B Local Sales] + [Shipment Rate B to A] - [Shipment Rate A to B] + ([B Metal Target Inventory] - [B Metal Inventory]) / [B Metal Adjustment Time] + [B Electronics Metal Input Delivery], [B Local Sales] + [Shipment Rate B to A] - [Shipment Rate A to B] + ([B Metal Target Inventory] - [B Metal Inventory]) / [B Metal Adjustment Time])

replace_formulas.name: A Effective Electronics Local Base Demand
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, IfThenElse([Test 19 Coupled Electronics Growth Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [v7.4 Coupled Electronics Growth Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 14 Sustained Electronics Growth Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [v7.3 Sustained Electronics Growth Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 13 Temporary Electronics Lifecycle Surge Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [v7.3 Temporary Electronics Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 9 Two Industry Energy Stress Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [Two Industry Energy Stress Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 8 Metal Priority Scarcity Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [Priority Stress Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 5 Electronics Demand Surge Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [Electronics Demand Surge Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 7 Two Good Transport Surge Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [Two Good Demand Surge Multiplier], [A Electronics Local Base Demand]))))))), IfThenElse([Test 14 Sustained Electronics Growth Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [v7.3 Sustained Electronics Growth Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 13 Temporary Electronics Lifecycle Surge Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [v7.3 Temporary Electronics Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 9 Two Industry Energy Stress Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [Two Industry Energy Stress Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 8 Metal Priority Scarcity Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [Priority Stress Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 5 Electronics Demand Surge Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [Electronics Demand Surge Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 7 Two Good Transport Surge Active] = 1, [A Electronics Local Base Demand] * [Two Good Demand Surge Multiplier], [A Electronics Local Base Demand])))))))

replace_formulas.name: B Effective Local Base Demand
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, IfThenElse([Test 20 Coupled Metal Demand Growth Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [v7.4 Coupled Metal Demand Growth Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 16 Sustained Metal Energy Growth Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [v7.3 Sustained Metal Demand Growth Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 9 Two Industry Energy Stress Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Two Industry Energy Stress Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 8 Metal Priority Scarcity Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Priority Stress Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 7 Two Good Transport Surge Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Two Good Demand Surge Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 2 Transport Surge Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Transport Demand Surge Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 3 Low Demand Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Low Demand Multiplier], [B Local Base Demand]))))))), IfThenElse([Test 16 Sustained Metal Energy Growth Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [v7.3 Sustained Metal Demand Growth Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 9 Two Industry Energy Stress Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Two Industry Energy Stress Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 8 Metal Priority Scarcity Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Priority Stress Demand Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 7 Two Good Transport Surge Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Two Good Demand Surge Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 2 Transport Surge Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Transport Demand Surge Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 3 Low Demand Active] = 1, [B Local Base Demand] * [Low Demand Multiplier], [B Local Base Demand])))))))

replace_formulas.name: B Effective Mining Capacity
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Intermediate Inputs Enabled] = 1, IfThenElse([Test 18 Metal Supply Shock Active] = 1, [B Mining Capacity] * [v7.4 Metal Supply Shock Multiplier], IfThenElse([Test 4 Reverse Advantage Active] = 1, [Reverse B Mining Capacity], [B Mining Capacity])), IfThenElse([Test 4 Reverse Advantage Active] = 1, [Reverse B Mining Capacity], [B Mining Capacity]))

add_scenarios.name: v7.4 Intermediate Inputs Baseline
add_scenarios.description: Coupled baseline with Metal as the physical Electronics intermediate input. No exogenous shock; used to verify going-concern behavior and the new physical/cost channels.

add_scenarios.name: v7.4 Temporary Metal Supply Shock
add_scenarios.description: Coupled economy. B mining capacity is reduced to 50% from day 360 to 720; the Metal shortage should propagate through Electronics input fulfillment, cost, output, and then recover.

add_scenarios.name: v7.4 Sustained Electronics Growth with Input Coupling
add_scenarios.description: Coupled economy. A Electronics local base demand rises 4x permanently from day 360, testing Metal input demand, refinery expansion and induced power-capital growth.

add_scenarios.name: v7.4 Coupled Metal Demand Growth
add_scenarios.description: Coupled economy. B final Metal local base demand doubles permanently from day 360, testing proportional competition between final and intermediate Metal demand and refinery adaptation.
